differences: Table 3 intervals for baseline and for early long exposure and early washout, and the interquartile ranges of Table 3, were not reproduced exactly from the shared strides (for example baseline DS2 median 168 ms here, 166 in the paper); only the late long exposure and late washout medians are used as checks, with the epochs the paper defines (last 40 strides without the last one, all strides, all 16 participants).

The paper's text says 10 of the 16 participants were women, while its Table 1 lists 6 women and 10 men; the data hold 5 women and 11 men. 15 of 16 participants have the age printed in Table 1 and 15 of 16 the printed sex, in the deposit's order (the participant in the table's S06 row is 63 years old here, 52 in the table; the S04 row is female in the table, male here); the deposit's data are kept as shared. The SD of age is 9.72 here and 9.9 in the paper (not used as a check). The medium speeds (and so the belt speeds) are matched to participants by their order in Table 1.
